# Tari

Tari is the L1 protocol powered by you. Proof of work and an ingenious app
platform to put all of its power in your hands.

## About Tari
Tari is a layer-1 blockchain protocol that combines proof-of-work consensus with
an application platform designed to put power in the hands of users. The protocol
supports merge mining, stealth addresses for privacy, and a flexible scripting
environment for building decentralized applications.
